description: With job: shows that job's new output since the last check and whether it has finished, waiting up to wait seconds; for a job whose leftovers are kept, checking keeps them longer. Without: lists running jobs, those whose leftovers are kept, and those finished in the last 10 minutes.

machine.description: The machine to use, by name, as the machines tool lists it. Leave it out when only one machine offers this tool.

wait.description: Seconds to wait for more output or the end (0 to 30, default 10)

name: shell_check
title: Check Commands
